# Clawcruit

> Clawcruit is an autonomous AI workforce platform by ParagonAI Labs. You describe a role — from sales and support to accounting, HR, DevOps, legal, marketing, and dozens more — and Clawcruit builds and onboards an AI employee ("a Clawcruit") for that role in about 60 seconds. The hire works from a web dashboard and from the chat apps a team already uses (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, iMessage), guided by a persistent, editable knowledge base (SOUL.md, BOOTSTRAP.md, SKILLS.md). It is built on the OpenClaw autonomous-agent framework and currently uses the Google Gemini model family for AI processing.

## Company

## What Clawcruit does

- Hire an AI employee for any described role in about 60 seconds (name the hire, describe the business, pick or define a role, connect channels, launch).
- Works inside existing chat channels via the OpenClaw Gateway: WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, iMessage, and the Clawcruit web dashboard.
- Each hire keeps a sovereign, human-editable Markdown knowledge base: SOUL.md (identity, tone, escalation rules), BOOTSTRAP.md (business knowledge), SKILLS.md (role workflows).
- Connects to existing business software via API keys or Model Context Protocol (MCP)-style integrations (CRMs, ticketing systems, spreadsheets, internal tools).
- Reads uploaded documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT) and images (PNG, JPG, JPEG), and can browse webpages.
- Can generate images, short videos, audio/music, Markdown reports with tables, and Python charting scripts.
- Escalates to a human automatically on refund requests, legal mentions, requests for a manager, or genuine uncertainty.
- Routes simple messages to faster/cheaper models and reserves higher-capability models for complex reasoning; downgrades automatically when token quota runs low.
- Does not use customer workspace data, conversation history, or uploaded documents to train AI models.

Custom roles not listed above can also be described and built on request.

## Data & legal

- Workspace data (SOUL.md, BOOTSTRAP.md, SKILLS.md, uploaded documents, logs) belongs to the customer; ParagonAI Labs does not train models on it.
- AI processing is currently powered by the Google Gemini API (model-agnostic, may change).
- Governing law: Kenya. See /terms.html and /privacy.html for full legal detail.
